The Council adopted draft S/2022/980 as resolution 2669 (2022), by 12 votes in favour, none against and three abstentions. The United Kingdom voted in favour. China, India and Russia abstained. The resolution demands an immediate end to violence, calls for humanitarian access, and acknowledges ASEAN's central role. It requests the Secretary-General or his Special Envoy, in coordination with the ASEAN Special Envoy, to report orally to the Security Council by 15 March 2023.

United Kingdom — “The United Kingdom submitted the draft” “consultations with Council members, ASEAN members and regional partners” “It emphasized ending violence, humanitarian access and support for ASEAN efforts.”

India as a delegation — “noted neighbouring countries' concerns” “advocated quiet, constructive diplomacy”

Council procedure — “India held the Council presidency. The President called the vote and announced adoption.” “India's representative later explained the national abstention”

Both delegations addressed regional concerns, while their votes differed.
